title: Video Editor
summary: Video editors turn raw footage into finished brand films, YouTube videos and short vertical clips for Reels and Shorts. They usually sit in a brand, growth or content team, or at a media studio, working with producers, designers and social media managers.
dailyDuties: Cut raw footage into first drafts from a brief or script
Edit vertical Reels and Shorts with hooks and captions
Add titles, lower thirds and simple animations
Correct and grade colour so shots match
Clean up audio and mix music and voiceover
Make revisions from producer and brand feedback
Export and deliver files to each platform's specs

skills.expectation: Cut brand, social and YouTube videos in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro
Edit vertical Reels and Shorts with hooks, pacing and captions that hold attention
Add titles, lower thirds and simple animations in After Effects
Correct and grade footage so shots match and skin tones look right
Clean up dialogue, balance music and sync voiceovers
Export the right codec, aspect ratio and size for each platform
Take briefs and feedback from producers and brand teams and turn revisions quickly
Manage several requests and deadlines from marketing teams
Use type, layout and colour well in on-screen text
Read watch time and retention data to improve edits
